    spec = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    n, h, w, fps = (spec.get("frames", 20), spec.get("height", 144), spec.get("width", 256), spec.get("fps", 4))
    assert frames.shape == (n, h, w, 3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8, frames.shape
    audio_spec = spec.get("audio")

    if audio_spec:

        pcm = np.asarray(audio)
        if pcm.ndim == 1:

        assert pcm.shape == (samples, audio_spec["channels"]) and pcm.dtype == np.int16, (pcm.shape, pcm.dtype)
        with wave.open(str(case_dir / "audio.wav"), "wb") as handle:
            handle.setnchannels(audio_spec["channels"])

            handle.writeframes(pcm.astype("<i2").tobytes())
        audio_url = "data:audio/wav;base64," + base64.b64encode((case_dir / "audio.wav").read_bytes()).decode()
    values = frames.astype(np.uint32)
    packed = (values[:, :, :, 0] << 16) | (values[:, :, :, 1] << 8) | values[:, :, :, 2]
    tensor = packed.transpose(1, 2, 0)

    folder = case_dir / "frames"

    outline=[(550,302),(602,280),(624,277),(808,301),(821,307),

        sprites[k]=(img[y0:y1,x0:x1].astype(np.float32),aa[y0:y1,x0:x1].astype(np.float32)/255,

    original_mass_ratio=.87

    v_ball=(1-restitution*heavy_mass_ratio)/(1+heavy_mass_ratio)*incoming

        wood_shadow=translate(dark,bx,by)
        scene*=1-wood_shadow

        spin_surface=7.1+(roll_speed-7.1)*min(t/slip_duration,1.)
        phase+=spin_surface/16.6

                M=np.float32([[scale,0,cx-scale*sx],[0,scale,cy-scale*sy]])
                ap=cv2.warpAffine(aa,M,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
                cp=cv2.warpAffine(rgb*aa[...,None],M,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
                alpha+=weight*ap;premult+=weight*cp
            scene=scene*(1-alpha[...,None])+premult
        # Ball is behind the wooden face at the instant of contact.
        ba=translate(block_alpha,bx,by)
        bc=translate(block_rgb*block_alpha[...,None],bx,by)
        scene=scene*(1-ba[...,None])+bc
        frames[i]=np.uint8(np.clip(np.rint(scene),0,255))
    artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)
    Image.fromarray(background).save(ROOT/'.tmp/background.png')
    print('Saved',frames.shape,'impulse velocities:',v_ball,v_block,'block travel',v_block*v_block/(2*floor_drag))
